discovery_notes: DLP 2015 backfill; 30 WebSearch calls, all search_snippet (search-tool summaries). Main sources: dein-dlrp.de monthly posts (all 12 months), Dedicated to DLP, Disney Pins Blog, Salon Mickey, passiondlp. No prior dlp/2015 keys existed. LE series (villains, stage show, Olaf) grouped across months.
